home.title: Work in the Gulf, with a company you can check.
home.lead: We help job seekers from India apply for jobs in the Gulf, and help employers there hire from India. Every fee is quoted in writing before you pay.
home.askFirst: Have a question first? <wa>Ask us on WhatsApp</wa>
home.whatsappGreeting: Hello Go Gulf, I have a question about working in the Gulf.

jobs.title: Jobs you can apply for now

seekers.title: Looking for work in the Gulf?
seekers.lead: Apply for a listed job online, or send a general application.
seekers.point1: See the place, the job details and — where the employer has shared it — the salary before you apply.
seekers.point2: Ask about any job on WhatsApp — its reference goes with your message.
seekers.point3: Every fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay.
seekers.more: How it works for job seekers

employers.title: Hiring for a Gulf operation?
employers.lead: Tell us the trades, headcount and timeline you need.
employers.point1: Candidates are shortlisted against the requirement you share.
employers.point2: Your requirement goes to our business team, separately from candidate enquiries.
employers.point3: Commercial terms are agreed with you in writing.

process.title: From your first enquiry to joining, in ten steps
process.lead: The same ten steps for every candidate, from the first enquiry to joining the employer.

s1.title: Job enquiry
s1.body: You apply for a job or send us an enquiry.

s2.title: Registration
s2.body: Your profile and documents are registered.

s3.title: Consultation
s3.body: Our team looks at the role, the country and your fit.

s4.title: Shortlisting
s4.body: Your profile is matched and shortlisted for the employer.

s5.title: Employer interview
s5.body: The interview is arranged between you and the employer.

s6.title: Selection and offer
s6.body: If you are selected, the employer issues an offer letter.

s7.title: Medical and documents
s7.body: Your medical test is done and your documents are checked.

s8.title: Visa and attestation
s8.body: Agreement, document attestation (including MOFA) and visa processing.

s9.title: Departure
s9.body: Immigration clearance and your flight ticket.

s10.title: Joining and support
s10.body: You join the employer abroad, with support after joining.

money.title: How we handle money
money.lead: Rules you can hold us to.
money.rule1: Every fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay. If a fee is not in writing, do not pay it.
money.rule2: Pay only into an account we have confirmed to you in writing. If anyone asks you to pay somewhere else, stop and contact us.
money.rule3: We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date. <terms>See our Terms & conditions</terms>.

cta.title: Start with a job — or a question
cta.lead: Apply online, or talk to us first on WhatsApp, phone or email.

aboutPage.title: A Lucknow company helping people work in the Gulf
aboutPage.lead: Go Gulf is a brand of {legalName}, a private limited company incorporated in India on {date}, with its registered office in {place}.

what.title: We work with job seekers and with employers
what.seekers: We list Gulf openings, take applications, and help with what a Gulf job needs — interviews, medicals, attestation, visas and travel.
what.employers: We take your requirement, screen and shortlist candidates against it, and coordinate the paperwork for the candidates you select.

mission.title: Transparency, at every step
mission.body: To connect job seekers in India with Gulf employers through ethical, transparent and technology-driven support — building successful careers and long-term business relationships.

vision.title: A name you can recognise and trust
vision.body: To become one of the most trusted and recognised names for Gulf careers, through reliable hiring support, useful technology and exceptional customer service.

rules.title: Three rules we keep
rules.r1: Every fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay.
rules.r2: We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date.
rules.r3: Our official numbers and addresses are listed on our Verify page. Check there before you act on a message in our name.

verifyPage.title: How to check you are dealing with Go Gulf
verifyPage.lead: Before you share documents or pay anything, check these details. Each one can be confirmed independently of us.

company.heading: The company behind Go Gulf
company.body: Go Gulf is a brand of {legalName}. You can look the company up on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs website using its CIN.
company.registration: A CIN shows that a company is incorporated and registered with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs. It identifies the company; it is not a licence for any particular line of business.

channels.heading: Our official contact details
channels.body: If someone claiming to be Go Gulf contacts you from a different number or address, check with us on these details before you act.

payments.heading: Our rules about payments
payments.r1: Every fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay. See <pricing>Pricing & fees</pricing>.
payments.r2: If you are asked to pay an account or a person that we have not confirmed to you in writing, stop and contact us before paying.
payments.r3: We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date. See our <terms>Terms & conditions</terms>.

report.heading: If something does not feel right
report.body: Tell us before you pay or send documents. Email {email} or call {phone}.

candidatesPage.title: Working in the Gulf, step by step
candidatesPage.lead: What happens when you apply through Go Gulf: the steps, the documents, the fees, and how to stay safe from fraud.
candidatesPage.whatsappGreeting: Hello Go Gulf, I would like to know how applying works.

steps.title: The ten steps, from enquiry to joining
steps.lead: Every candidate goes through the same steps, in this order.

documents.title: What you need, and when
documents.lead: You need very little to apply. More documents come later, once an employer has selected you.
documents.apply3: Certificates and experience letters, if you have them
documents.laterNote: Our team tells you what each step needs when you reach it.

fees.title: What you pay, and when
fees.lead: Some of our services carry a fee. None is payable until it has been quoted to you in writing.
fees.rule1: Every fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay.
fees.rule2: Pay only into an account we have confirmed to you in writing.
fees.rule3: Government, embassy, attestation, medical and travel costs are separate, and are identified to you as such.
fees.rule4: We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date.

safety.title: How not to be cheated
safety.lead: People sometimes pretend to offer Gulf jobs — or pretend to be us — to take money. These checks protect you.
safety.check1: Our phone and WhatsApp number and our email addresses are listed here and on our Verify page. If someone uses our name from another number, check with us first.
safety.check2Title: Never pay without a written quote
safety.check2: If anyone asks you for money without a written quote from Go Gulf, do not pay.
safety.check3: Go Gulf is a brand of a registered company. You can look up its CIN on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs website.
safety.check4: If something does not feel right, tell us before you pay or send documents.

faq.title: Common questions
faq.q1: Does Go Gulf guarantee me a job or a visa?
faq.a1: No. We do not guarantee selection, employment, a visa or a joining date. <terms>Our Terms & conditions</terms> explain this.
faq.q2: How will I know what I have to pay?
faq.a2: Every fee is quoted to you in writing before you pay. If a fee has not been quoted in writing, do not pay it. <pricing>Pricing & fees</pricing> explains how our fees work.
faq.q3: What do I need to apply?
faq.a3: Your CV and a copy of your passport. You can add certificates and experience letters too.
faq.a4: You get a confirmation email with a reference number, and our team contacts you about the next step.
faq.q5: Can I ask about a job before I apply?
faq.a5: Yes. Ask us on WhatsApp. If you ask from a job’s page, the job’s reference goes with your message.
faq.q6: How can I check I am really dealing with Go Gulf?
faq.a6: Use only the contact details on our <verify>Verify page</verify>, and look up the company’s CIN on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs website.
